style.why: The draft reads naturally and follows the house style well: it uses first-person British English, connects sentences with 'Following...', and ends with a narrowing list of teammates. The hook (most expensive GK) is specific and memorable enough for a fan quiz, though not quite as charming or twisty.
style.fix: The main weakness is factual accuracy regarding the final clue: Riccardo Calafiori (Tonali) joined Arsenal in January 2025, whereas Ramsdale was already on loan at Nottingham Forest by then and had left Arsenal's first-team squad earlier.
